dog.description_text:
💕 MEET ELEANOR — “ELLIE” 💕

🐶 Female🎂 Age: 13+ weeks at transport⚖️ Weight: Currently 14 lbs.🐾 Breed: Listed as German Shepherd Mix; possibly German Pinscher or Min Pin Mix

Ellie's story is a little different from most puppies—and she's going to need a very special person who understands that earning her trust will take time. ❤️
Ellie was found at just 13 weeks old living alone in a culvert. Based on how frightened she was of people when rescued, it's possible she was born to a street dog
dog.name: ELEANOR
